breakdown.description: The two-hole plate is posed in plane stress, but the constitutive relation switches to the unreduced Lamé law
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the provided Lamé parameter was for a full (unreduced) constitutive law, which is incorrect for a plane-stress problem. It replaced this incorrect instruction with the correct one: 'The constitutive response will use the reduced plane-stress formulation for a unit thickness.' This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
